138    def get_info_page_parts(self, frame_dim,
139                                font=Fonts.MINECRAFT,
140                                hmargin=0, vmargin = 0,
141                                chars_per_line=50, lines_per_page=5,
142                                height_distributions=[0.1, 0.05, 0.45, 0.1, 0.25, 0.05]
143                                ):#equals: headline area, distance, card image area, distance, textbox area, distance)
144
145
146        stats_hp = 0.2
147        stats_insert_index = 3
148
149        adjust = (stats_hp - height_distributions[stats_insert_index])
150
151        tweight = sum([height_distributions[i] for i in range(len(height_distributions)) if i != stats_insert_index])
152
153        height_distributions = list(map(lambda x: x - (x / tweight) * adjust, height_distributions))
154        height_distributions[stats_insert_index] = stats_hp
155
156        areas = self.get_areas(frame_dim, height_distributions, hmargin, vmargin)
157        stats_text_area = areas[stats_insert_index]
158
159        page_padding = 2
160
161        stats_page = [
162                        [("Lives: ", Colors.RED), (f"{self.lives}", Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR)],
163                        [("Inventory Size: ", Colors.BLUE), (f"{self.inventory_size}", Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR)]
164                        ]
165
166        for i in range(page_padding):
167            stats_page.insert(0, [])
168            stats_page.append([])
169
170        page_parts = Renderable_CardInfo.get_info_page_parts(self,
171                                                        frame_dim,
172                                                        font=font,
173                                                        hmargin=hmargin,
174                                                        vmargin=vmargin,
175                                                        chars_per_line=chars_per_line,
176                                                        lines_per_page=lines_per_page,
177                                                        height_distributions=height_distributions
178                                                        )
179
180        tbox = page_parts.areas[4]
181        textbox_ref = page_parts.textbox
182
183        tag_headline_page = [[[("Tags", Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR)]]]
184
185        tag_pages = []
186
187        for tag in self.tags:
188
189            strag = str(tag)
190            lines = strag.splitlines()
191            for line in lines:
192                tag_pages.append((line, tag.tag_color))
193                tag_pages.append(graphics.NL)
194
195        tag_pages = graphics.page_by_chars_color(tag_pages, line_length=chars_per_line, paragraph_length=lines_per_page)
196
197        if tag_pages:
198            last_page = tag_pages[-1]
199            if len(last_page) < lines_per_page:
200                last_page.extend([[]] * (lines_per_page - len(last_page)))
201
202            textbox_ref.add_pages(tag_headline_page)
203            textbox_ref.add_pages(tag_pages)
204
205        rendered_stats_page = graphics.render_page_from_chars_color(
206                                    font,
207                                    stats_page,
208                                    stats_text_area,
209                                    text_color=Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR,
210                                    vertical_centered = True
211                                )
212
213        rstats = []
214
215        for surf, (x, y) in rendered_stats_page:
216            rstats.append((surf, (x + tbox.x - stats_text_area.x, y)))
217
218        page_parts_container = ExplorerInfo.ExplorerInfoPagePartContainer(page_parts, rstats)
219
220        return page_parts_container
221
222    def render_info_page_parts(self,
223                                screen,
224                                info_page_part_container,
225                                page_index=-1,
226                                background_color=Colors.BLACK,
227                                textbox_outline_size=None,
228                                textbox_outline_color=None,
229                                full_image_shown=False
230                                ):
231
232        Renderable_CardInfo.render_info_page_parts(self,
233                                    screen,
234                                    info_page_part_container=info_page_part_container,
235                                    page_index=page_index,
236                                    background_color=background_color,
237                                    textbox_outline_size=textbox_outline_size,
238                                    textbox_outline_color=textbox_outline_color,
239                                    full_image_shown=False
240                                    )
241
242        stats_page = info_page_part_container.rendered_stats
243
244        for surf, pos in stats_page:
245            screen.blit(surf, pos)
246
247        if full_image_shown:
248
249            full_image, full_image_pos = info_page_part_container.full_image_surface, info_page_part_container.full_image_pos
250
251            tsurf = pygame.Surface(screen.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
252            tsurf.fill((*Colors.BLACK, 180))
253
254            tsurf.blit(full_image, full_image_pos)
255
256            screen.blit(tsurf, (0, 0))

271    def __init__(self, modules, einfo=None, frame_enum=FrameEnums.PLAYSET_ENTITY, data=None, frame_dim=constants.FULLSCREEN, parent_frame=None):

283        self.deck = Deck()#current deck

285        self.trunk = {}#card enum: number of cards, total amount of cards possessed
286        self.blueprints = []#blueprint: Blueprint instance

294    def check_activation(self):
295        #receives the data, and if the card can be activated it should return True, else False
296        return False
297
298    def initialize_activation(self):
299        pass
300
301
302    def load_instances(self):
303
304        """
305        loads the instances from the info, deletes all previous data
306        """
307
308        self.lives = self.info.lives
309        self.max_inventory_size = self.info.inventory_size
310
311        self.inventory = []
312        for key, value in self.info.starting_items.items():
313            self.inventory.extend([self.mappings.item_mappings[key](self.modules) for i in range(value)])
314
315        self.active_supporters = []
316        self.inactive_supporters = []
317        for key, value in self.info.starting_supporters.items():
318            self.inactive_supporters.extend([self.mappings.supporter_mappings[key](self.modules) for i in range(value)])
319
320        self.trunk = self.info.starting_cards.copy()
321
322        self.blueprints = []
323        for key, value in self.info.starting_blueprints.items():
324            self.blueprints.extend([self.mappings.blueprint_mappings[key](self.modules) for i in range(value)])
325
326        self.packs = self.info.starting_packs.copy()
327        self.unlocked_packs = self.info.unlocked_packs.copy()
328        self.unlockable_packs = self.info.unlockable_packs.copy()
329
330    def inventory_weight(self):
331        return sum([item_.info.weight for item_ in self.inventory])
332
333    def free_inventory_weight(self):
334        return max(self.max_inventory_size - sum([item_.info.weight for item_ in self.inventory]), 0)
335
336
337    def add_item(self, item_enum, amount=1):
338        #adds an item into the inventory, if the inventory is big enough
339        new_item_ref = self.mappings.item_mappings[item_enum]
340
341        if new_item_ref.info().weight > self.free_inventory_weight():
342            return False
343        else:
344            for i in range(amount):
345                self.inventory.append(new_item_ref(self.modules))
346            return True

This class defines how the info text for a card is is rendered. The info text describes the cards functionality.

This class works by first getting the page parts to render with positions as a container class using Renderable_CardInfo.get_info_page_parts, then some time later rendering the page parts to the given screen by passing the container class to Renderable_CardInfo.render_info_page_parts

def get_info_page_parts( self, frame_dim, font='BaseAssets\\Fonts\\Minecraft.ttf', hmargin=0, vmargin=0, chars_per_line=50, lines_per_page=5, height_distributions=[0.1, 0.05, 0.45, 0.1, 0.25, 0.05]): 
140    def get_info_page_parts(self, frame_dim,
141                                font=Fonts.MINECRAFT,
142                                hmargin=0, vmargin = 0,
143                                chars_per_line=50, lines_per_page=5,
144                                height_distributions=[0.1, 0.05, 0.45, 0.1, 0.25, 0.05]
145                                ):#equals: headline area, distance, card image area, distance, textbox area, distance)
146
147
148        stats_hp = 0.2
149        stats_insert_index = 3
150
151        adjust = (stats_hp - height_distributions[stats_insert_index])
152
153        tweight = sum([height_distributions[i] for i in range(len(height_distributions)) if i != stats_insert_index])
154
155        height_distributions = list(map(lambda x: x - (x / tweight) * adjust, height_distributions))
156        height_distributions[stats_insert_index] = stats_hp
157
158        areas = self.get_areas(frame_dim, height_distributions, hmargin, vmargin)
159        stats_text_area = areas[stats_insert_index]
160
161        page_padding = 2
162
163        stats_page = [
164                        [("Lives: ", Colors.RED), (f"{self.lives}", Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR)],
165                        [("Inventory Size: ", Colors.BLUE), (f"{self.inventory_size}", Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR)]
166                        ]
167
168        for i in range(page_padding):
169            stats_page.insert(0, [])
170            stats_page.append([])
171
172        page_parts = Renderable_CardInfo.get_info_page_parts(self,
173                                                        frame_dim,
174                                                        font=font,
175                                                        hmargin=hmargin,
176                                                        vmargin=vmargin,
177                                                        chars_per_line=chars_per_line,
178                                                        lines_per_page=lines_per_page,
179                                                        height_distributions=height_distributions
180                                                        )
181
182        tbox = page_parts.areas[4]
183        textbox_ref = page_parts.textbox
184
185        tag_headline_page = [[[("Tags", Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR)]]]
186
187        tag_pages = []
188
189        for tag in self.tags:
190
191            strag = str(tag)
192            lines = strag.splitlines()
193            for line in lines:
194                tag_pages.append((line, tag.tag_color))
195                tag_pages.append(graphics.NL)
196
197        tag_pages = graphics.page_by_chars_color(tag_pages, line_length=chars_per_line, paragraph_length=lines_per_page)
198
199        if tag_pages:
200            last_page = tag_pages[-1]
201            if len(last_page) < lines_per_page:
202                last_page.extend([[]] * (lines_per_page - len(last_page)))
203
204            textbox_ref.add_pages(tag_headline_page)
205            textbox_ref.add_pages(tag_pages)
206
207        rendered_stats_page = graphics.render_page_from_chars_color(
208                                    font,
209                                    stats_page,
210                                    stats_text_area,
211                                    text_color=Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR,
212                                    vertical_centered = True
213                                )
214
215        rstats = []
216
217        for surf, (x, y) in rendered_stats_page:
218            rstats.append((surf, (x + tbox.x - stats_text_area.x, y)))
219
220        page_parts_container = ExplorerInfo.ExplorerInfoPagePartContainer(page_parts, rstats)
221
222        return page_parts_container

Renders all significant parts for the info page, then returns a InfoPagePartContainer object.

hmargin and vmargin specify the margins applied to frame_dim before rendering.

def render_info_page_parts( self, screen, info_page_part_container, page_index=-1, background_color=(0, 0, 0), textbox_outline_size=None, textbox_outline_color=None, full_image_shown=False): 
224    def render_info_page_parts(self,
225                                screen,
226                                info_page_part_container,
227                                page_index=-1,
228                                background_color=Colors.BLACK,
229                                textbox_outline_size=None,
230                                textbox_outline_color=None,
231                                full_image_shown=False
232                                ):
233
234        Renderable_CardInfo.render_info_page_parts(self,
235                                    screen,
236                                    info_page_part_container=info_page_part_container,
237                                    page_index=page_index,
238                                    background_color=background_color,
239                                    textbox_outline_size=textbox_outline_size,
240                                    textbox_outline_color=textbox_outline_color,
241                                    full_image_shown=False
242                                    )
243
244        stats_page = info_page_part_container.rendered_stats
245
246        for surf, pos in stats_page:
247            screen.blit(surf, pos)
248
249        if full_image_shown:
250
251            full_image, full_image_pos = info_page_part_container.full_image_surface, info_page_part_container.full_image_pos
252
253            tsurf = pygame.Surface(screen.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
254            tsurf.fill((*Colors.BLACK, 180))
255
256            tsurf.blit(full_image, full_image_pos)
257
258            screen.blit(tsurf, (0, 0))

Given the surface to render onto and the info_page_part_container, this function renders the info page onto screen. page_index specifies the page shown inside the textbox, background_color the background color of the info frame. If full_image_shown == True, the full image will be shown on top of the info page.
